bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/enteric_dis.short_description: Value for the enteric disease measure identified by the measure column: cumulative year-to-date case counts as reported through the NNDSS, or monthly isolate counts/rates as reported through the CDC BEAM Dashboard.

bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_diarrh.short_description: Value for the Epic Cosmos measure identified by the measure column: weekly encounter counts, or the percentage of encounters attributable to all-cause diarrhea.

bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_diarrh.long_name: Suppression flag for the value in this row
bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_diarrh.short_description: Binary indicator: 1 if the value in this row was suppressed and imputed, 0 otherwise.
bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_diarrh.long_description: Binary indicator: 1 if the count underlying the value in this row had fewer than 10 encounters in the strata and was therefore suppressed and imputed as 5, 0 otherwise. For percentage measures the flag is 1 if either the numerator or the denominator count was suppressed.
Age group, based on age in current years. "Total" rows cover all ages combined.

bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_health.short_description: State or county name (e.g., 'Iowa', 'Los Angeles County'); the paired `fips` column holds the FIPS code and `geography_level` says which level the row is.
Week-ending (Saturday) date of the snapshot in which the alert was active (ISO date).
The condition for which Epic Research flagged the geography with an active health alert. All conditions published on the page are kept, not only enteric ones.
Epic Research's estimated onset date of the elevated activity for this geography and condition (ISO date).

bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_health.long_name: Epic Research Health Alert Rate, Cases per 100,000 (Latest Week)
bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_health.short_description: Latest-week case rate per 100,000 for a state or county flagged with an active Epic Research health alert; the alerted condition is given in the `condition` column.
bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_health.long_description: Case rate per 100,000 people for the most recent week, for a state or county currently flagged with an active Epic Research Health Alert. Alerts are derived from Epic Cosmos electronic health record data and are published only while active, so the source dataset accumulates one weekly snapshot per ingestion run. Rates marked as a partial (incomplete) reporting week on the source page are flagged in `partial_week_flag`.

bundle_enteric_diseases/dist/epic_health.short_description: Binary indicator: 1 if the rate reflects a partial (incomplete) reporting week and may rise as more data arrives, 0 otherwise.
Date on which the ingestion script downloaded the Epic Research health-alerts page and recorded this row (ISO date).
The page-wide 'Last updated' date shown on the Epic Research health-alerts page at scrape time (ISO date).

beam.name: BEAM Dashboard - Report Data
beam.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
beam.location: BEAM (Bacteria, Enterics, Amoeba, and Mycotics) Dashboard
beam.description: The BEAM Dashboard is an interactive tool built on the System for Enteric Disease Response, Investigation, and Coordination (SEDRIC) that provides timely data on enteric pathogen trends and serotype details to support prevention of illnesses from food, water, and animal contact. Monthly isolate counts by state and pathogen (Campylobacter, Salmonella, Shigella, STEC, Vibrio), aggregated across source type, source site, and serotype/species. National values are computed by PopHIVE/Ingest as the sum across all reporting states.
beam.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

narms_now.description: Antimicrobial resistance data from NARMS human clinical isolates, including resistance by individual agent and by multi-drug resistance pattern. Data from the NARMS Now Power BI dashboard.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. Weekly counts of encounters with all-cause diarrhea ICD-10-CM codes (A00-A09, R19.7) are reported by state and age, both for emergency department encounters and for encounters of any type, alongside all-cause encounter denominators. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed as 5.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'

epic_health_alerts.name: Epic Research Health Alerts
epic_health_alerts.description: Epic Research Health Alerts flag U.S. states and counties experiencing an unusual rise in specific conditions, derived from Epic Cosmos de-identified electronic health record data covering over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems. Each alert reports the latest-week case rate per 100,000 and an estimated onset date. The page is a live snapshot showing only currently active alerts rather than a historical archive, so the source dataset accumulates one weekly snapshot per ingestion run to construct a time series.
epic_health_alerts.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
